0.0.1-release.description:
### 0.0.1 Initial release -- Human Campaign only
This is the first release of Archipelago warcraft 3, featuring just the human campaign. Note night elf and most tavern heroes are still disabled in the hero selection as their corrupted variants for Human 9 are not implemented yet.

### Installation instructions
* archipelago.w3n should be placed in the Documents/Warcraft III/Campaigns folder
* wc3.apworld should be installed with your existing Archipelago installation, either by putting it in custom_worlds/ or installing it through the launcher
* The template yaml is provided for your convenience, and also because I believe the template generated by the Archipelago launcher doesn't give the best introduction to yaml. It is formatted slightly differently, but has all the same options

#### If you're playing on wc3 1.29 or older
On older versions of Warcraft 3, you must set a registry key to allow preloader communication (which this mod uses).
* Run regedit (On linux, you can also run regedit under the same wineprefix as your game, it's under `drive_c/windows/regedit.exe`)
* Navigate to key `HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Blizzard Entertainment\Warcraft III`
* Add a DWORD key `Allow Local Files`
* Set the value of `Allow Local Files` to 1

#### If you're playing on Reforged
I'm declaring this unsupported on account of being unable to start the Reforged client at all on my machine. Users have reported communication issues with reforged, I'm unable to do anything about them.

### Known Issues
Currently there aren't any known bugs outstanding.

Currently there's poor control over what hero gets tomes -- it'll go to whatever hero most recently picked up an item, and transfer the target if that hero dies. This won't be fixed in this release.

There's poor visibility into what checks you've done and what items you have. The best recourse is to use the `/missing` and `/received` commands in the Archipelago client. An in-game way to accomplish something similar may come in a future release, but not this one.
